description: Apply a filter from the Filter menu to pixel layers (inside the selection, if there is one). The Filter Gallery filters (Artistic, Brush Strokes, Sketch, Texture, glowing_edges), filter_gallery (the whole gallery stack), shape_blur, mezzotint and adaptive_wide_angle have no options here: they use the settings last used in their dialog or the Filter Gallery. diffuse, extrude and lens_correction (Filter > Lens Correction) apply only the settings given; the rest keep the values last used in the dialog. Filters without an object-model method act through the active layer, which ends on the last target. Options by type: gaussian_blur (radius); motion_blur (angle, distance); smart_blur (radius, threshold, quality, mode); blur; blur_more; average; unsharp_mask (amount, radius, threshold); sharpen; sharpen_more; sharpen_edges; high_pass (radius); add_noise (amount, distribution, monochromatic); median (radius); despeckle; dust_and_scratches (radius, threshold); maximum (radius, preserve); minimum (radius, preserve); pinch (amount); twirl (angle); ocean_ripple (size, magnitude); diffuse_glow (graininess, glowAmount, clearAmount); offset (horizontal, vertical, undefinedAreas); clouds; difference_clouds; ntsc_colors; box_blur (radius); surface_blur (radius, threshold); shape_blur; lens_blur (source, focalDistance, invert, shape, radius, bladeCurvature, rotation, brightness, threshold, noiseAmount, noiseDistribution, monochromatic);
